# Third-Party Infigo Content — Index

Sources outside infigo.net itself: trade press, partner blogs, competitor comparisons, customer reviews, and integration vendor announcements. Curated for material that adds real-world deployment lessons, comparison context, or technical signal beyond Infigo's marketing.

## Highest-value docs (start here)

| Doc | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| [capterra-infigo-verified-reviews.md](capterra-infigo-verified-reviews.md) | 17 verified user reviews including direct comparisons to XMPie Circle, Pressero, MyOrderDesk, PersonalEffect StoreFlow. Most honest signal on Infigo pros/cons from real admins. |
| [onprintshop-top-10-w2p-blog.md](onprintshop-top-10-w2p-blog.md) | Direct competitor's 2026 assessment with named 2025 product changes (EAA compliance, OAuth 2.0, Square + Global Payments, PrintIQ ANZ reseller). |

| [piworld-how-printers-win-with-w2p.md](piworld-how-printers-win-with-w2p.md) | Sean Owen (CEO, Talient Action Group) on the record: 26% direct-to-press auto rate, 8–12 min/job savings, deployment-as-people-commitment warning. |
